title: game-state
description: The game state is the complete set of information describing the current situation of a game at a moment: whose turn it is, what resources each player holds, what has happened, what actions are available. Freeze the game and hand it to a stranger — the game state is everything they need to continue correctly.

complete.description: The state suffices to continue play correctly; anything needed to resume that is not in the state is not yet part of the state.

public.description: Information visible to all players (the board position, the score).

private.description: Information held by one player (a hand of cards, a planned strategy).

hidden.description: Information hidden from all players (the undrawn deck's order). An empty private and hidden partition is a perfect-information game; otherwise imperfect information.
